period.cutoff_basis: document date in the company timezone: invoices.issued_at, payments.timestamp

fx.quote: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency (major units)
fx.rate_date: document date in the company timezone (not the UTC date)
fx.missing_rate: use the last rate published on or before that date (no weekend rates)
fx.invoice_rate: invoices are booked at the rate of their own date
fx.payment_rate: payments are booked at the rate of their own date
fx.settlement: accounts_receivable is cleared at the invoice's own rate; the difference goes to fx_gain_loss
fx.refund: refunds clear unapplied_cash at the rate of the refunded payment

rounding.scope: each converted ledger line is rounded once to a whole base-currency minor unit

allocation.invoice_refs: applied_minor is in the payment currency, which always equals the invoice currency
allocation.unapplied: any part of a receipt not applied to an invoice is credited to unapplied_cash

accounts.accounts_receivable: Amounts customers owe on invoices (base currency)
accounts.unapplied_cash: Cash received but not allocated to any invoice
accounts.bank:<CCY>: Bank account held in <CCY>, carried at base-currency equivalent
